name: search-hub.research
purpose: One federated project-research call at a named effort level (fast, standard, deep), returning bounded ranked rows plus routing meta and a verdict the skill branches on.

effort.description: fast: classifier, limit 5; standard: classifier, limit 10; deep: every active provider, limit 20. Rows returned are capped at 6; ranked_count carries the total.

types.description: Explicit leaf-type tokens; the vocabulary of record is `search-hub providers list --json` `.providers[].type` (the program library is `library`). Overrides the classifier and the deep fan-out.

group.description: Scope the fan-out to one scenario's leaves.

scope.description: Optional corpus facet passed to scoped providers.

assumptions: search-hub is running and search-hub/query/query is reachable from the kernel
the kernel passes `type` as a list of strings; a comma-joined string is refused by the proto encoder
the caller treats status unavailable as unknown and zero_result as a verdict, never as failure
when the router's reranker leg is absent the response has no fused `ranked` rows and every hit is in meta `groups[].hits`; the program reads them from the same call
invariants: exactly one binding call per run; no retry, no second query; the groups field is read from that call's meta()
no binding with effect write or destructive is called
ranked rows are at most 6 with snippets cut to 60 characters; nothing else is materialized; the envelope stays under the 4 KB stdout bound
a reranker outage is verdict answered_degraded with class reranker_absent; it is never zero_result and never sets escalate_to_web
the envelope is printed exactly once, on every path

signals.verdict: one of answered, answered_degraded, zero_result, no_provider_selected, unavailable
signals.ranked: at most 6 hits (5 for fast) as {id,title,provider_id,type,path,score,rerank_score,snippet}; snippets cut to 60 characters so the envelope fits the 4 KB stdout bound
signals.ranked_count: count of hits: the fused ranked rows, or every groups[].hits entry when ranked is empty
signals.ranked_source: ranked when the rows are the router's fused list; groups when they were read from groups[].hits (reranker absent) and are ordered by provider score
signals.corpora_searched: first 6 provider ids the router searched
signals.corpora_count: count of provider ids the router searched
signals.providers_hit: provider id to count among the returned rows
signals.routing_degrade_reason: router's degrade reason string when degraded
signals.partial: some provider legs had not answered within the timeout
signals.pending_providers: count of legs still pending when partial
signals.latency_ms: federated latency of this query as an integer (cast from the protojson int64 string)
signals.reranker_leg: which reranker ordered the rows; none when the leg is absent
signals.escalate_to_web: true only when the verdict is zero_result or no_provider_selected and web was not among the types

inputs.query: how does search hub route queries

fixtures.note: With the reranker leg absent this returns partial, verdict answered_degraded, ranked_source groups; it must not return zero_result.
